codeReviewFindings: The only imported product-source change since the prior READY commit adds synchronous rendering of a closed lazy jump target before land795 and updates its comment. The candidate is exactly the new READY patch applied to verified v8.06 plus the v8.07 release marker.
The immediate-jump branch first opens the fold and persists its name in folds795, then calls renderProgress. The resolver passed to land795 follows the replacement connected element after the redraw.

Original moneySummary_ is unchanged and receives asOf only through const day = asOf || todayIso(); downstream date-sensitive calls use day. Wrapper canonicalisation preserves default and explicit-day semantics.
The beforeprint handler checks active Today tab, progress-pane placement and lazy content before renderProgress. Its full flag is restored even when rendering throws.

The print and toggle/jump handlers contain no direct record or service mutation calls. renderProgress retains its existing assignment of the Today display list; the Equipment print guard prevents a hidden Today redraw from replacing Equipment selection.
All extension scripts remain unchanged; only the existing main business script changes.
limits: CPU and source inspection only; no browser, visual inspection, PDF rendering, performance measurement or service access.
Print-hook fixtures use stubbed renderProgress and a minimal DOM. They verify branch guards, flag cleanup and unchanged test list identity, not complete page rendering.

Immediate-jump fixtures use the exact extracted candidate onclick body with stubbed renderProgress, jump799 and land795. They verify synchronous order and replacement-node resolution, not pixel position, scrolling, focus or browser toggle-event scheduling.
No product files were edited. Patch checks used temporary files; only this evidence JSON was saved to the repository.
Actual browser rendering, output figures, PDF layout, focus, device behaviour and final publication require the parent release checks.
